# 2026-08-04 — Site Walkthrough PDF

**Deliverable:** `Muse-Site-Walkthrough.pdf` (repo root, ~7.5MB, 17 pages)
**Source:** `walkthrough-src/` (screenshots gitignored, regenerated by `shoot.py`)

Built on the muse-pdf system, same as the structure walkthrough.

## What it is

Every page of muse.sa in both languages, on desktop and mobile:

- 10 routes, each shown with the first desktop screen, the last desktop
  screen (footer), and the mobile hero screen, in EN and AR
- Key copy quoted verbatim from `messages/*.json` + `lib/content/*.ts`,
  both locales
- Landing and the three service pages get a full page per language;
  explore/about/careers/contact/get-started/newsletter get one compact
  bilingual page each
- Last page: legal summaries (privacy 5 sections, terms 6), 404, and where
  the strings live

## Notes

- Screenshots taken from the local staging build (1440px + 390px viewports)
- Mobile full-page screenshots turned out ~13,000px tall, so the mobile
  hero screen stands in for them; quoted copy covers the rest
- Verified: measure.py all pages within bounds, fonts are Space Grotesk +
  IBM Plex Sans Arabic only, no em/en dashes or curly quotes, 17 pages
- The 40 F-flagged Arabic strings still await the native review; the
  walkthrough quotes the current staging copy as-is
